from.name: Duḥkhī  (Domestic attendant in the house of Śrīvāsa)

fields.name: Sukhī (Duḥkhī, servant in Śrīvāsa's house)
fields.notes:
The domestic helper in the house of Śrīvāsa who served Lord Gaurāṅga with great care. Her name was Duḥkhī; pleased with her service Lord Caitanya named her Sukhī (Caitanya-bhāgavata Madhya 25.11-22).

The record «Duḥkhī» #229 was the same person and was joined to this one (07-11-2026).

A resident of Orissa, Janārdana was a great devotee and a permanent sevaka of Lord Jagannātha in Purī. Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya introduced him to Lord Caitanya when the Lord returned from His pilgrimage of South India (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Madhya 10.41).

The record «Janārdana» #592 (the same text) was joined to this one (07-11-2026).
